scope: MPU-6515 accelerometer accuracy, inv_mpu6050 offset handling, IMU supply and mounting matrix

six_position.method: owner placed the phone in six resting orientations; 100-sample means of in_accel_*_raw x in_accel_scale (m/s^2), chip axes, identity matrix
six_position.conclusion: sensitivity is correct on all axes; the 0.90 g screen-up reading is a +98 mg Z zero-g offset (MPU-6500 family initial Z tolerance is about +-80 mg). The private stock calibration applies unity scale, so it does not encode a sensitivity correction either.

offset_stride.finding: MPU-6500-map parts keep accelerometer offsets at 0x77/0x78, 0x7a/0x7b, 0x7d/0x7e (0x79 and 0x7c reserved); inv_mpu6050 uses a two-register stride, so in_accel_y/z_calibbias hit 0x79/0x7a and 0x7b/0x7c
offset_stride.evidence: bytes from 0x77: ed 10 00 f3 5e 00 23 38; lowering 0x7d by one moved Z by -2007 counts at +-2 g; writing in_accel_z_calibbias on the unfixed driver left Z unchanged
offset_stride.fix: fx0-linux 2ebba2c0ab26 (Fixes: 33da559f861b); on r16 writing Z calibbias 9016 -> 8810 moved screen-up Z from -14792 to -16450 counts (-1.004 g)

calibbias_read_pm.finding: CALIBBIAS reads access the chip without a runtime resume; with the Fx0 supplies off the I2C bus is dead and reads block on timeouts
calibbias_read_pm.fix: fx0-linux 21508b9dbbcb (Fixes: 4599cac84614); on r16 all three reads from a suspended chip return in under 105 ms

imu_supply.finding: DT listed LVS1 only as vddio; the driver switches vddio off at autosuspend, which removed all power; after resume SMPLRT_DIV/CONFIG/GYRO_CONFIG/ACCEL_CONFIG/ACCEL_CONFIG2 read 00 while the driver reported a +-2000 dps gyro scale (gyro readings 8x too large), and calibbias reverted to OTP
imu_supply.fix: fx0-linux d02a6c3f57d2 vdd-supply = LVS1; RAM-boot test: LVS1 held, calibbias 8810 survives autosuspend, registers after resume 13 04 18 00 04 (50 Hz, 20 Hz DLPF, +-2000 dps)

board.mount_matrix: fx0-linux 6161d5c2ee3a: device x = chip +Y, device y = chip +X, device z = chip -Z (from the six positions)

open: install r17 and confirm the mounting matrix with iio-sensor-proxy
optional per-device Z offset correction through in_accel_z_calibbias (now persistent)
